entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana... I'm calling about my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so sad about it. It seems to be completely not working, and I'm really disappointed.
Oh no, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault, for sure. The band just won't sync with my phone or the app, no matter what I do. I've tried all the troubleshooting steps. I think the one I got is just broken.
I see, a sync issue can be very frustrating. I understand you've already tried some steps, but could you tell me a little more about what's happening when you try to connect it?

It just never shows up. My phone can't find it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I saved up for this... I just feel like the product I received is defective. I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work properly.

I completely understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Let me pull up your order and check our policies to see what the best next step is. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. Just one moment while I review your account... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 19 days ago. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Okay... I hope something can be done.
Alright, I've just consulted our policy, and it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process a return for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful. So I can just send it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're reporting the item is defective and you're within the timeframe, I've just initiated that for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes.
Wow. Diana, thank you so much! That is such a huge relief. You have been incredibly helpful.
You are very welcome. I'm glad we could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
